title: 乡村振兴之路
text: 一座古老的石桥横跨在村口。周围的农田呈现出深绿色。这种景象标志着农村面貌发生了剧变。许多年轻人选择离开城市回乡创业。他们带来了先进的管理理念。这种转变既带来了资金又注入了活力。现代农业开始取代传统耕作方式。数字化平台让农产品直接进入市场。中间环节被大幅削减。农民的收入因此显著提高。基础设施得到了全面升级。宽带网络覆盖了每个角落。交通便利程度大大增强。这种发展既提高了生活质量又增强了竞争力。生态环境得到了有效保护。绿色产业成为了新的增长点。旅游业与农业深度融合。游客们在这里寻找宁静。当地文化资源被重新挖掘。传统手工艺品重新受到关注。教育资源分配变得更加公平。乡村学校配备了现代化设备。医疗服务体系更加完善。居民能够在家门口看病。这种良性循环促进了社会稳定。乡村不再是落后的代名词。它成为了创新实验的田地。未来的农村将更加繁荣。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what do young people returning from cities bring to rural areas?
options: Advanced management ideas, capital, and vitality
Only cheap labor
Foreign investment exclusively from overseas
Nothing of practical value

questions.prompt: How have digital platforms changed the way farm products reach the market?
options: They let products go directly to market, reducing middlemen and raising farmer income
They eliminated the need for farming altogether
They only benefit large corporations, not individual farmers
They decreased farmer income due to platform fees

questions.prompt: What has happened to medical services in rural areas, according to the text?
options: The system has become more complete, letting residents see doctors near home
Medical services have been eliminated entirely
Residents must travel to cities for any medical care
Medical services remain unchanged

questions.prompt: What role does tourism play in the rural transformation described?
options: It integrates deeply with agriculture, attracting tourists seeking tranquility
It has replaced agriculture entirely
It has caused pollution and been discouraged
It has no connection to local culture

questions.prompt: How does the text characterize rural areas at the end of the passage?
options: No longer a symbol of backwardness, but a field for innovative experimentation
Still hopelessly behind urban areas
Declining in population with no future
Exclusively agricultural with no other industries

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
